title: Echo Protocol announces wind-down of lending, strategy and liquid staking
description: Echo Protocol announced that core products would cease new deposits, borrowing and staking and began phased exits. Borrower repayment was directed by November 14, 2026, followed by a November 19, 2026 23:59 UTC exit deadline. Residual positions and the aBTC redemption bridge require separate follow-up rather than assuming all services have already terminated.
notes: Reviewed from contemporaneous reports of the operator announcement. November deadlines are prospective as of October 22; later liquidation and distributions are undetermined.
